A One-of-One Adventure · for Yajur and Pooja

Scoop, Scoop,
Hooray!

Or: The Day Yajur Heard the Jingle

written with love, for Yajur

Chapter One

The Warmest Day

The sun came out on the hottest day,
It shined and shined and chased the clouds away.
And little Yajur, by the window pane,
said, "What a day for something sweet again!"

Chapter Two

The Far-Off Jingle

Then — far away — a tiny sound,
a tinkly jingle rolling round.
Ding-ding-ding! It came in close,
and Yajur sniffed a waffle's smell!

Chapter Three

The Ice Cream Truck

Around the corner, pink and bright,
the ice cream truck came into sight!
It parked right by Yajur's door,
and wiggled its wheels — one, two, three, four!

Chapter Four

Which Scoop?

Chocolate, strawberry, or vanilla?
"Three scoops!" said Yajur, "I'll take it all-a!"
The shopkeeper piled it high and tall —
the biggest, best cone of them all!

Chapter Five

The First Big Lick

One big lick — and POP! went the joy!
Wide, wide eyes from the little boy.
The sweet cold treat, the perfect tongue —
"Best ice cream," he cried, "on the planet!"

Chapter Six

The Sneaky Drip

But wait! A drip began to race,
a slippery, sneaky, speedy case.
It slid down the cone without a stop,
while the old dog watched till the final plop!

Chapter Seven

Sweet, Sweet Dreams

The sun went down, the stars came out,
and Yajur slept without a doubt —
with a sticky hand and a happy heart,
dreaming of the truck that made a sweet start!

For You

With All Our Love

For Yajur — may every day
be a little sweeter in every way.
And for Pooja, who shares it all —

For Yajur, for every scoop, for Pooja ❤
with love — the jingle's yours, whenever it calls.
